items.source: Note: Since JDBC 4.0, it has been clarified that any methods using a String to identify the column should be using the column label. The column label is assigned using the ALIAS keyword in the SQL query string. When the query doesn't use an ALIAS, the default label is the column name. Most JDBC ResultSet implementations follow this pattern, but there are exceptions such as the com.sun.rowset.CachedRowSetImpl class which only uses the column name, ignoring any column labels. ResultSetWrappingSqlRowSet will translate column labels to the correct column index to provide better support for com.sun.rowset.CachedRowSetImpl which is the default implementation used by JdbcTemplate when working with RowSets.
items.translation: 注意：自 JDBC 4.0 起，已明确说明任何使用 String 来标识列的方法都应使用列标签。列标签是在 SQL 查询字符串中使用 ALIAS 关键字分配的。当查询未使用 ALIAS 时，默认标签为列名。大多数 JDBC ResultSet 实现遵循此模式，但也存在例外情况，例如 com.sun.rowset.CachedRowSetImpl 类，它仅使用列名而忽略任何列标签。ResultSetWrappingSqlRowSet 会将列标签转换为正确的列索引，从而为 com.sun.rowset.CachedRowSetImpl（这是JdbcTemplate在处理 RowSets 时使用的默认实现）提供更好的支持。

items.source: The passed-in ResultSet should already be disconnected if the SqlRowSet is supposed to be usable in a disconnected fashion. This means that you will usually pass in a javax.sql.rowset.CachedRowSet, which implements the ResultSet interface.
items.translation: 传入的 ResultSet 应该已经断开连接，以便 SqlRowSet 能够以断开连接的方式使用。这意味着您通常会传入一个 `javax.sql.rowset.CachedRowSet`，它实现了 ResultSet 接口。

items.source: Note: This class implements the java.io.Serializable marker interface through the SqlRowSet interface, but is only actually serializable if the disconnected ResultSet/RowSet contained in it is serializable. Most CachedRowSet implementations are actually serializable, so serialization should usually work.
items.translation: 注意：该类通过 SqlRowSet 接口实现了 `java.io.Serializable` 标记接口，但仅当其中包含的已断开连接的 ResultSet/RowSet 可序列化时，该类才真正可序列化。大多数 CachedRowSet 实现实际上是可序列化的，因此序列化通常可以正常工作。

items.source: Note that you must first call one of the getter methods and then call the wasNull() method.
items.translation: 注意，您必须先调用其中一个 getter 方法，然后调用wasNull() 方法。
